title: Review of c20's neural-field comets on a regrowing resource (SIMED): replicated on fresh seeds 3 and 4; cutting resource recovery everywhere kills all 35-42 comets by t~620, a left-half cut kills the 21-22 left-half comets while the right half keeps 13-17
summary: c20's world.py unchanged on fresh seeds 3 and 4 (128^2, t=1000, labkit at spf 50): the fed run, recovery of r cut everywhere at t=500 (cut_t 500), and cut in the left half only (cut_half 1), all identical until the fork; counted with c20's forkcount.py (forkcount_s3.png, forkcount_s4.png). Fed: comets form from noise by t~40, glide up to 26-34 body lengths and multiply by break-up (15 and 28 persistent splits, generation 3 and 4, merge/split 0.30 and 0.25; fed/seed3/sheet.png); 35-42 comets at t=500 and 40-44 at t=1000. Cut everywhere: 0 comets in either half by t=750 on both seeds (all die within ~120 t). Cut left: left-half comets 21 -> 0 (seed 3) and 22 -> 0-1 (seed 4) by t=750, while right-half comets stay 14 -> 14 -> 17 and 20 -> 15 -> 13 (fed twin right half 14-23 and 20-22). So each comet depends on the resource where it is; the cost on the fed side (13 vs 22 on seed 4) is comets that wander into the starved half.

verdicts.limitation: E is by construction (the coupling acts on r f(u)); comets are activity pulses with no material boundary, and the 'resource' is synaptic efficacy, so B is not at issue here. I did not re-run the depression ablation (kd 0) behind D.
